source: ScanNet v2 (Dai et al., CVPR 2017): label-filt/<frame>.png raw ScanNet ids mapped to NYU40 ids through scannetv2-labels.combined.tsv (id -> nyu40id) by usplat.datasets.ScanNetDataset; the class ids below are NYU40 ids
class_set: the 19 classes of OpenGaussian's ScanNet evaluation (Wu et al., NeurIPS 2024; github.com/yanmin-wu/OpenGaussian scripts/eval_scannet.py, target_id '# 19', read 2026-10-10): the 20 ScanNet benchmark classes without 'otherfurniture'. The concurrent NormLift reports ScanNet on the same 19 classes (OpenGaussian protocol). 'other furniture' is a residual category, not a nameable concept for a text query. FIXED 2026-10-10 before any ScanNet run.
ignore_note: 0 = unannotated (and raw ids the tsv does not list); every NYU40 id outside the 19 classes (blinds, shelves, ..., otherstructure, otherfurniture, otherprop) is ignored, as in the ScanNet benchmark
template: a photo of a {} in a room.
template_note: the Replica templates, frozen 2026-09-29 on the Replica validation scenes (configs/vocab_replica.json), reused unchanged: nothing is tuned on ScanNet
query_rule: the classes present (GT pixels > 0) in each evaluated scene's evaluation frames
prompt_rule: prompt = the NYU40 class name with spaces (no prompt tuning)

lseg: there is a {} in the scene.
a photo of a {} in a room.
